play_equipment.evidence: A dark round object at the right edge, near (615,340), could be a trampoline. It sits at or just beyond the yellow outline boundary, so it probably belongs to a neighbouring lot.

signals.notes: The house has a brownish-red roof with some discoloration and a rear deck on the east side. A paved driveway to the north has no vehicles. Mature trees on the west and south sides partly shade the lot, and there is open lawn to the east.
